purpose: Scan the compressed keep-specific GOBP panel (1691 sets) around TLS-pool anchors with the v5 conditioned near-far contrast. Screen only: nominate candidates, make no claims.

panel.rule: keep-specific (ascending size; a term is dropped if it is an ancestor of an already kept term), size floor 20 raw genes, Jaccard 0.7, no depth window, no size cap
panel.notes: the surviving 1248-gene set is flagged in the summary (large terms can survive when no descendant passes the floor); sets outside definitions.json (4) and sets with cohort coverage <10 are reported but not filtered here

scoring.operator: identical formula to tls_pool_expand.aucell: rank 1 = highest expression, contribution clip(max_rank - rank + 1, 0), divided by (k * max_rank), max_frac 0.05
scoring.speed: one rank pass per section; all 1691 sets scored by a single sparse product
scoring.equivalence_gate: before any scan row is written, 5 random panel sets are compared against tls_pool_expand.aucell on the same section; max |diff| must be <= 1e-6, otherwise the run aborts

metric.distance: edge distance to the nearest anchor spot; spots assigned by Voronoi to that anchor's component; own-component ring 1.3*pitch excluded
metric.bins: 0,100,...,1000 um; at least 5 spots per bin per anchor
metric.section_statistic: median delta over anchors; section evaluable if >=8 anchors carry both bins

arms.own: readout minus its projection on [deciles of the spot's own detection score] + quadratic tissue trend
arms.local: same projection using deciles of the 300 um-smoothed detection score (over-corrects by construction; reported, not used for claims)

metric.detection_field: 57-gene B/plasma/chemokine signature, top-10% threshold, components at 1.3*pitch, min_size 2 (identical to the pool and v4/v5)

screen_rule.claims: none. All values are NOT_CALIBRATED; this round may only nominate candidates.
screen_rule.ranking: own_median descending, own_pos_frac as consistency; raw_median/raw_pos_frac reported alongside
screen_rule.calibration_deferred: a matched-autocorrelation surrogate null (v5.0 design) will be run only for the top 50 sets by own_median, in a separate round with its own contract
screen_rule.multiple_testing_context: 1691 sets; the binomial reference for a set reaching >=60% positive sections out of 53 by chance is reported next to the summary
screen_rule.circularity: any set whose overlap with the 57-gene detection signature is >=20% of the set is flagged; those cannot carry a biological claim

exclusions.visiumhd: included but flagged; giant components (up to 4612 spots) make its geometry unreliable
